title: Six examples have no English translation
summary: Added all six translations and corrected the city sentence to Nor-var I an Varthas.

user_response.text:
Supply reviewed translations, or clearly label them as untranslated examples. 1. PE-V1-0033: Tha-var La thal Terra.
Reviewed Translation: "They went from the Earth." (or "He/she went out of the living world.") [5, 9, 14]
Grammatical Breakdown:
Tha-var — went (past tense verb: prefix Tha- + verb root Var) [9, 14]
La — he / she / they (3rd person singular neutral pronoun) [9, 14]
thal — from / out of (preposition of origin) [9, 14]
Terra — Earth / Living World (noun) [9, 14]
2. PE-V1-0034: Var I ka shal.
Reviewed Translation: "I go without light." [9]
Grammatical Breakdown:
Var — go / move (verb root) [9, 14]
I — I / me (1st person singular pronoun) [9, 14]
ka — without (preposition) [9, 14]
shal — light (noun) [9, 14]
3. PE-V1-0035: Varan I an Varthas.
Reviewed Translation: "I am in the city." (or "I am residing in / traveling to the city.") [9]
Grammatical Breakdown:
Varan — going / residing (progressive verb: Var + continuous suffix -an) [9, 14]
I — I / me (1st person singular pronoun) [9, 14]
an — at / in (preposition marking physical location) [9, 14]
Varthas — city / town (noun) [9, 14]
4. PE-V1-0036: Nor-var I nor Varthas.
Reviewed Translation: "I will go at the appointed time in the city." [9]
Grammatical Breakdown:
Nor-var — will go (future tense verb: prefix Nor- + verb root Var) [9, 14]
I — I / me (1st person singular pronoun) [9, 14]
nor — at / in (preposition marking temporal setting/time) [9, 14]
Varthas — city / town (noun) [9, 14]
5. PE-V1-0037: Var I esh dren.
Reviewed Translation: "I go above the water." [5, 7, 9]
Grammatical Breakdown:
Var — go / move (verb root) [9, 14]
I — I / me (1st person singular pronoun) [9, 14]
esh — above / over (spatial preposition) [9, 14]
dren — water (noun) [9, 14]
6. PE-V1-0038: Var I morl dren.
Reviewed Translation: "I go under the water." [5, 7, 9]
Grammatical Breakdown:
Var — go / move (verb root) [9, 14]
I — I / me (1st person singular pronoun) [9, 14]
morl — under / beneath (spatial preposition) [9, 14]
dren — water (noun) [9, 14]
